description: This file contains an interrupt service routine (ISR) for the AT91RM9200 microcontroller, specifically handling AIC (Advanced Interrupt Controller) interrupts. It sets up context saving, calls a C handler, and restores context, managing mode switches between IRQ and SYS mode within ARM assembly code.

methods.name: AT91F_ST_ASM_HANDLER
methods.description: ARM assembly routine that handles the AIC interrupt, saving register state, switching modes, calling the C handler, and restoring state.

calls: ADJUST AND SAVE LR_irq in IRQ stack
Write in the IVR to support Protect Mode
Save SPSR and r0 in IRQ stack
Enable Interrupt and Switch in SYS Mode
Call the C handler at AT91F_ST_HANDLER
Disable Interrupt and switch back in IRQ mode
Mark the End of Interrupt on the AIC
Restore SPSR_irq and r0 from IRQ stack
Restore adjusted LR_irq from IRQ stack directly in the PC
